              type: string
              example: 'NSW26A1B2C3D48'
              readOnly: true

              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID

              example: '5b8e2a44-1f3c-3e9a-9c7d-0a1b2c3d4e5f'
              readOnly: true

              title: Identity key
              description: "The derived duplicate-detection key formatted as 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email empty when absent)."
              type: string

              readOnly: true

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points

              minimum: 0

              readOnly: true

              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true

              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:

              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true

        status:

          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true

          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Optional when a structured addressLine1 is supplied; on read it is the composed normalized address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat address when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: 'Apt 4'

          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison

          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+()\d\s-]+$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com

          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be valid for the city's region.
          type: string
          pattern: '^\d{4}$'

          format: date

          title: Birth date

          format: date

      description: A pet owner.

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation formatted as 'title lastName', or just lastName when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: "The owner's member ID formatted as '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region code, the 2-digit fiscal year, the first eight upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and a single Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'."

              readOnly: true

              type: integer

              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
